title: Tricliniary
summary: TRICLIN'IARY, adjective [Latin tricliniaris, from triclinium, a couch to recline on at dinner.] Pertaining to a couch for dining, or to the ancient mode of reclining at table.

inlines.v: TRICLIN'IARY, adjective [Latin tricliniaris, from triclinium, a couch to recline on at dinner.] Pertaining to a couch for dining, or to the ancient mode of reclining at table.
